author: Will DeBouver
text: We needed a septic tank inspection for a home we have a contract on. We went with Bobs, and Bob called me personally to let me know the crew was on the way. They actually arrived early and had the pumping hoses hooked up when I arrived. David was friendly and professional and Kenny, Bobs grandson,  was doing the work. Even though the inspection revealed cracks in the tank, they did not try and sell me a new tank. They just wrote it up and gave me a quote for a new tank. The price was fair and even included a 5% veteran discount. Highly recommended!!

author: Alexis Mazariegos
text: They were absolutely great! Very respectful and kind and will definitely be using them anytime I have issues with the septic! Also very informative on how to clean out the filter! 10/10 great service!

author: Louis Camacho
text: I do not recommend Bob’s 24 Hour Septic due to extremely poor customer service. I called two days in a row as instructed because there was an issue with the service vehicle. When I called the second morning, the person I spoke with was very rude, yelled at me, and said, “Don’t call me, I’ll call you,” before hanging up. When I tried to explaon back to apologize and clarify, so plan if able to do service or not so I can plan or plan someone else but was ignored he hung.the call on my face This was very unprofessional and disappointing. But now looking on review everything seems happen for a reason so im glad I didn't get service so went with  call John & John septic

author: Kayla Schwebke
text: Bob was great came out to the house and fixed the problem right away. Didn’t try to up charge me he actually inspected the septic tank to solve the problem. Will defiantly be using this company again!!!

author: YANARY GONZALEZ
text: We called him to do a septic tank inspection for the home that we are buying. He came the next day when he did the inspection he said the tank had cracks so it failed the inspection. He sent us a quote of $11,900 for a new septic tank. We got a second opinion because we didn’t believe the tank was in bad condition. The second inspection came and assured us that the tank was perfectly fine , no cracks and working fine . So in other words Bob’s Septic Tank we’re trying to rip us off with $11,900 with a new septic tank that we didn’t need.
